g.text: GDHUB-97 — a stage's text and the goals live in the workflow template

text.tspan: The workflow's goal and each step's goal: plain text, for the AI only
each step's text: an Editor.js editor (images → Sanity)
its steps copy the template's name, order and tasks
its text is the template step's of the same order
rendered with the shared Editor.js renderers
reads the stage goal and the workflow goal

g.text: One text and one goal per template step: an edit reaches every project on the template, old ones too
A goal belongs to its step, not to a stage name: renaming a stage keeps its goal
Goals are read by the AI curator only; the author sees the stage's text, never a goal
No text is a plain empty line, never an error or an endless skeleton
English only; nothing else in the step changes — name, tasks, conditions, order
Images in a stage's text are uploaded to Sanity through /api/file, never linked from elsewhere
edits the goals and a stage's text

text.tspan: Save — one PUT for the template
an empty steps array is refused
